title: pecluma chiapensis
intro: Pecluma chiapensis, commonly known as the Chiapas rabbit's foot fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and inflammation. The health benefits of Pecluma chiapensis include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in soothing skin irritations and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
